# Fonts

The typefaces the trackside sponsors' posters and banners are lettered in
(`SPONSOR_ART` in `game.js`). Each is the Latin subset of an open-licence
font, copied from its `@fontsource` package on npm so nothing loads from
another site. All are under the SIL Open Font License 1.1: each one's licence
and copyright notice is beside it here.

| File | Typeface | Used for |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `charis-sil-700.woff2` | Charis SIL Bold | PWD, and the numeral on Tenth Floor Chambers |
| `overpass-800.woff2` | Overpass ExtraBold | Frangos' small print |
| `caprasimo-400.woff2` | Caprasimo | Glory Dates |
| `cormorant-garamond-600.woff2` | Cormorant Garamond SemiBold | Tenth Floor Chambers |
| `anton-400.woff2` | Anton | Frangos |

The fifth sponsor, Nine Mile, isn't set in a typeface: its wordmark is drawn in
code (`NM_LETTERS` in `game.js`).
